protocol: --metric prints the best decode wall-clock over --repeats (default 5) within one process. Five independent process invocations, JIT-warm within each, machine otherwise idle. Reported value is the median of the five invocation bests. Run in a clean `env -i` process with HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 and PYTHONPATH=.

baseline.note: No same-host baseline exists: this is the first recorded Framework Desktop row for this model. The zbook row is a different physical machine and must not be read as an old->new delta.

cross_lane.interpretation: Absolute rate difference between two physical gfx1151 hosts (power- and heat-limited zbook vs Framework Desktop). This is a host/thermal lane difference, not a code improvement, and is not retainable as an old->new metric delta. No same-host A/B was performed because no code changed.
